question:
The following sportspersons have created a record in their sports in 2022. Match the sportsperson (list I) with their sport (list II).

 
 

 
 
**List I (Sportsperson)**

 
 
 
**List II (Sport)**

 
 
 

 
 
a)

 
 
 
Manpreet Kaur

 
 
 
i)<

options.text: a – ii; b – i; c – iv; d – iii
a – i; b – ii; c – iii; d – iv
a – ii; b – i; c – iii; d – iv
a – i; b – ii; c – iv; d – iii

solution:
The correct answer is *__**a-i, b-ii, c-iv, d-iii.**__*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manpreet Kaur** is a renowned Indian athlete who specializes in the **Shot put**. She has set remarkable records in this field. Hence, a matches with i.
 
• **Avinash Sable** is an exceptional **Athlete** known for his achievements in the track and field events, particularly in steeplechase. Hence, b matches with ii.
 
• **Mirabai Chanu** is a celebrated Indian sportsperson in the field of **Weightlifting**. She has garnered international recognition for her performances. Hence, c matches with iv.
 
• **Pooja Jatyan** is an accomplished **Archer** who has made significant contributions and achieved records in archery. Hence, d matches with iii.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Shot put:**__

 __
 
• Shot put is a track and field event involving "putting" (pushing rather than throwing) a heavy spherical object—the shot—as far as possible.
 
• It requires a combination of strength, technique, and explosive power.
 
 
 
• **Athletics:**__
 __
 
• Athletics includes a variety of events such as running, jumping, and throwing.
 
• Avinash Sable is specifically known for his prowess in steeplechase, a distance track running event.
 
 
 
• **Weightlifting:**__
 __
 
• Weightlifting is a sport in which athletes attempt a maximum-weight single lift of a barbell loaded with weight plates.
 
• Mirabai Chanu has excelled in this sport, winning numerous medals at international competitions.
 
 
 
• **Archery:**__
 
 
• Archery is a sport that involves shooting arrows at a target for accuracy from a set distance.
 
• Pooja Jatyan has made significant strides in this sport, representing India at various international platforms.
